# Tool4SaaS (125 free tools across 12 categories + guides)
> Updated: 2026-10-29 · visible count excludes 2 NOINDEX pages (pdf-compress, fancy-text-generator).

> Free, privacy-friendly online productivity and developer tools. Most run entirely in your browser with no account and no upload; 4 network tools (currency, YouTube thumbnails, SSL checker, voice input) need internet - see /privacy. 125 tools across 12 categories + pillar/cluster guides below. Full FAQ + step hints for AI citations: https://tool4saas.com/llms-full.txt

## Overview

- [Generators](https://tool4saas.com/category/generators): Generate strong passwords and passphrases, random numbers, strings and UUIDs, coin flips, dice rolls, favicons and robots.txt with 8 free privacy-friendly generator tools.
- [Images & Design](https://tool4saas.com/category/images-design): Generate QR codes, compress, resize, crop and frame images, extract colors and build gradients with 12 free design tools offline.
- [PDF Tools](https://tool4saas.com/category/pdf): Merge, split, compress and convert PDFs and images to PDF securely in your browser with 4 free offline PDF utilities.
- [Calculators](https://tool4saas.com/category/calculators): Calculate percentages, loans, grades, discounts and BMI instantly with 11 free everyday calculators that work offline.
